objective: Connect AUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED recovery to the existing real main-frame WebContents document lifecycle without claiming PDD authentication truth or adding login automation.

confirmed.value: The authorized local detector emits auth_reauth_required from Signal A or Signal B.
Signal A requires the exact title/message pair in one modal: 登录过期 / 登录已过期，请重新登录.
Signal B requires origin https://mms.pinduoduo.com and pathname /login/.
The runtime latch emits once per page-runtime instance and same-runtime readiness, marker disappearance, URL changes, DOM mutation, and readiness cannot clear it.

The Main-side WebContents lifecycle is wired for real main-frame document boundaries, generation-tagged observation, and lifecycle failure handling; an executable production PDD navigation entry is not present/proven.
READY remains local page/runtime readiness and does not assert authenticated, session-valid, seller-verified, authorized, entitled, or send-ready.
ERROR, DOM_UNSUPPORTED, LOGIN_REQUIRED, AUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED, and DISPOSED remain distinct local states.
Session identity isolation and the status-only renderer projection remain enforced.

inferred.value: The exact Signal A and Signal B observations are sufficient for this minimum local detector contract, but do not establish platform authentication truth or natural-expiry semantics.

blocked.value: No production PDD loadURL() or configured navigation entry is present/proven; end-to-end production recovery cannot be validated from the current code.

deferred.value: Natural expiry semantics remain unproven and are not implemented.
Live PDD authentication/session truth, credential acquisition, login automation, and PDD runtime integration remain outside this unit.

blockers.value: No production PDD loadURL() or configured navigation entry is present/proven; end-to-end production recovery cannot be validated from the current code.

signal_a.rule: One modal surface must contain both exact title and exact message.
signal_a.title: 登录过期
signal_a.message: 登录已过期，请重新登录

rules: AUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED takes precedence over local READY, LOGIN_REQUIRED, and DOM_UNSUPPORTED observations within the same runtime latch.
A different session_id cannot mutate the host.
DISPOSED remains the terminal local lifecycle state when disposal is requested.

webcontents_lifecycle.navigation_start: Main-frame, non-in-place did-start-navigation starts a new document generation and enters LOADING.
webcontents_lifecycle.dom_ready: Main-frame dom-ready starts observation once for the active generation through pdd-page-lifecycle-start.
webcontents_lifecycle.load_failure: Main-frame did-fail-load and render-process-gone transition a loading document to local ERROR.
webcontents_lifecycle.same_document_navigation: In-place/hash navigation does not start recovery.

recovery_lifecycle.document_generation: Main assigns a generation per observed document; page events must carry the active generation after real navigation, and stale or untagged real-document events are rejected.
recovery_lifecycle.recovery_path: Fixture load/reload retains explicit legacy fixture compatibility. Real WebContents navigation mechanics are wired, but no executable production PDD navigation entry is present/proven.

natural_expiry.meaning: The detector does not claim that natural platform session expiry has been observed or fully characterized.

host_main_integration.host: PddSessionHost consumes auth_reauth_required and transitions the existing local session state.
host_main_integration.main: No credential acquisition, login, session validation, platform network, or PDD protocol behavior was added.

ipc_boundary.lifecycle_channel: pdd-page-lifecycle-start carries only session_id, shop_id, and document_generation to the isolated PDD preload.
ipc_boundary.renderer_projection: Existing status-only application-renderer projection; no raw ipcRenderer, filesystem, SQLite, credential, or unrestricted system API exposure.

negative_tests.name: Auth detector negative cases: generic, partial, stale-content, wrong-origin, and wrong-path inputs
Auth latch negative cases: same-runtime clearing and cross-session mutation
Real document lifecycle boundary: untagged page_ready after navigation, stale generation, and same-document navigation
